title_cn: 特朗普称韩国拒绝帮助伊朗
summary: President Donald Trump says he ordered the Pentagon to substantially cut back on joint military exercises with South Korea because the country would not support the war with Iran. He speaks to reporters in the White House. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Says Oman Hasn’t Behaved Very Well (Q&A)
title_cn: 特朗普称阿曼表现不佳（问答）
summary: Trump spoke to reporters in the Oval Office saying Oman hasn’t behaved well, “but we’d handle them very easily.” He also touched on possible talks with North Korea, when asked if Kim had replied to entreaties for talks, Trump said “he has” without elaborating. The president called the development “very positive.” The White House did not immediately respond to a request for further details. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Kushner, Netanyahu Set Disarmament as Condition for IDF Withdrawal From Gaza
title_cn: 库什纳和内塔尼亚胡将解除武装作为以色列国防军从加沙撤军的条件
summary: Jared Kushner assured Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu that the Israeli army won’t be compelled to withdraw from Gaza until Hamas disarms, an official with knowledge of the talks said, a stance that will dim hopes for a Gaza peace deal anytime soon.

title: Trump Says Strait Is Open, US Is in Control
